say:0:1210703001:0.text: Ugh, when was the last time these guys showered? These clothes stink!
say:0:1210703001:0.source_cn: 呃，水鬼帮是在泥浆里和猪打过架吗？我要被熏晕了！

say:1:1210703002:0.text: Come on, let's test out our disguises.
say:1:1210703002:0.source_cn: 走，试试这帮蠢蛋能不能认出我们。

say:6:1210705005:0.text: Ah, let me think. I got into a brawl with some dirty seadogs last night, so my head's still kinda fuzzy.
say:6:1210705005:0.source_cn: ——啊，让我想想，昨天酒喝多，和人打了一架，脑子还没缓过来。

say:11:1210705006:0.text: Psst. Why would we even need a password? Do you think he's suspicious of us?
say:11:1210705006:0.source_cn: 为什么还有暗号这种东西，我们是不是要暴露了？

say:12:1210705007:0.text: Sinbad, do you actually know the password?
say:12:1210705007:0.source_cn: 辛巴达，你知道暗号是什么吗？

say:13:1210705008:0.text: Don't rush me! Give me some space to hit my creative groove.

say:18:1210705010:0.text: I can just knock him out—

say:24:1210705012:0.text: Lemme slip you a little something. You haven't eaten yet today, right? Here's some freshly caught fish.
say:24:1210705012:0.source_cn: 刚钓的鱼，肉质鲜嫩，笑纳。

say:25:1210705013:0.text: Oh... This looks really tempting, but I really can't let you pass without a password.
say:25:1210705013:0.source_cn: 算你上道，但是暗号还是要——

say:26:1210705014:0.text: Alright, alright. How long has your shift been? You probably wouldn't fill up on just one fish. Lucky for you, I got another one in my bag!
say:26:1210705014:0.source_cn: 我懂，我懂，瞧我这脑子，这还有两条，都孝敬您了。

say:27:1210705015:0.text: Ah, jeez. You know my weak spot! Alright, buddy. Go on through and leave me to enjoy this fish in peace. And don't get involved in too many brawls in the future, alright?
say:27:1210705015:0.source_cn: 哼，悠着点，别把脑子都泡酒坛里了，过去吧。

say:0:1210706001:0.text: Did you just bribe him... with fish?
say:0:1210706001:0.source_cn: 不是要暗号吗？怎么给条鱼就行了？

say:1:1210706002:0.text: Aha, every man of the sea has something in common, and that's the love for scrumptious feasts!
say:1:1210706002:0.source_cn: 水鬼帮的暗号就是“上贡”。

say:3:1210707002:0.text: I haven't seen your faces before. Which group are you from?
say:3:1210707002:0.source_cn: 我没见过你们，混哪条道上的。

say:4:1210707003:0.text: Ah, if it isn't Leeko! How's your luck been?
say:4:1210707003:0.source_cn: 啊，这不是我莱克大哥吗？最近手气怎么样？

say:6:1210707005:0.text: Sinbad! Don't you remember? We caught those water rats together, and we had a fantastic night at the tavern afterwards. Great food, beautiful women...
say:6:1210707005:0.source_cn: 辛巴！我们一起抓过水耗子的，忘了？您不是还被水耗子爬了脸？

say:7:1210707006:0.text: ... Oh! Sounds familiar. I must've had one too many tankards!

say:8:1210707007:0.text: Well, I got a pretty good memory. I just remembered that you love sea bream. I caught two just for you, fresh as they come!
say:8:1210707007:0.source_cn: 我记得您喜欢吃孔雀鱼，我特意打了两条。您瞧刚出水的，可...

say:9:1210707008:0.text: Alright, you're in the know, but things have been tight lately. I gotta follow protocol. Which path are you on?
say:9:1210707008:0.source_cn: 算你上道，但最近帮里抓的严，还是得走下流程，你混的哪条道？

say:10:1210707009:0.text: Heaven, earth, water, wights—name a path, and I've walked it.
say:10:1210707009:0.source_cn: 天道地道水道鬼道，有哪条道混哪条道。

say:11:1210707010:0.text: And for the rest of you. What kinda fish do you like?

say:13:1210707012:0.text: You've already answered, my question was for your buddies.
say:13:1210707012:0.source_cn: 你已经答过了，让他们几个回答。

say:14:1210707013:0.text: So, out with it. What's your type of catch?

choice_prompt:15:1210707013.text: So, out with it. What's your type of catch?

say:16:1210707014:0.text: A proper Water Wight wouldn't be caught dead eating flame-tailed fish. You must be a spy from the Whispers!
say:16:1210707014:0.source_cn: 水鬼哪有吃焰尾鱼的，你们一定是血薇帮的探子！

say:18:1210707015:0.text: Who among the Wights doesn't like fish? You lot are getting more suspicious by the second.
say:18:1210707015:0.source_cn: 水鬼的弟兄里哪有不爱吃鱼的，你们肯定心里有鬼！

choice:15:1:2.text: I'm not a big fan of seafood.
choice:15:1:2.male: I'm not a big fan of seafood.
choice:15:1:2.female: I'm not a big fan of seafood.

say:19:1210707016:0.text: *Belly laughter* That's the spirit! Big or small, no fish or Whisper can slip the Wights' grasp!
say:19:1210707016:0.source_cn: 哈哈，天大地大，什么鱼鬼小鬼都逃不出水鬼的手心！

choice:15:2:3.text: I'll eat any fish out there.
choice:15:2:3.male: I'll eat any fish out there.
choice:15:2:3.female: I'll eat any fish out there.

say:2:1210708001:0.text: Sinbad, what did you mean by "water rats"? How were you so good at conversation with that guy?
say:2:1210708001:0.source_cn: 辛巴达，水耗子是什么意思？你为什么对水鬼帮的事这么了解？

say:3:1210708002:0.text: "Catching water rats" is code for nabbing spies from the Whispers. They've been trying to infiltrate the Water Wights too.
say:3:1210708002:0.source_cn: 抓水耗子就是抓血薇帮的间谍，血薇帮也想派人渗透水鬼帮的。

say:6:1210708003:0.text: How many Whispers members have you sold out?
say:6:1210708003:0.source_cn: 你卖了多少血薇帮的弟兄？

say:7:1210708004:0.text: Don't give me that look! I've never sold anyone out. I've even let a few go when I ran into them!
say:7:1210708004:0.source_cn: 别瞪我，我不仅没卖，还放了不少。

say:8:1210708005:0.text: Do you really think that low of me, that I'd work with the Water Wights just for money?
say:8:1210708005:0.source_cn: 难道你们以为我帮水鬼办事，就是为了钱？

say:9:1210708006:0.text: You know what working with them has got me? I know all their camp locations, the origins of their members, their daily routines, and even the types of fish they take as bribes!
say:9:1210708006:0.source_cn: 嘿，那我为什么连他们的营地分布，成员来源，日常爱干什么...

say:10:1210708007:0.text: I've been waiting for the day to dismantle them completely!
say:10:1210708007:0.source_cn: 我等的就是把他们连根拔起的这一天呢！

say:11:1210708008:0.text: Hm, it's rare for me to be impressed. Do you know where they could have hidden Tesio?
say:11:1210708008:0.source_cn: 干得不错，你知道水鬼会把泰西欧藏在哪里吗？

say:12:1210708009:0.text: Knowing Tesio, he wouldn't rough it with the Water Wights in tents...
say:12:1210708009:0.source_cn: 以泰西欧的性格，肯定不愿意在野外和水鬼挤帐篷……

say:14:1210708011:0.text: The Chainkeeper is the Wights' flagship, rivaling even the beautiful Immortal that the Dead Tide Fleet owns! I heard that's where the Wights' boss stays.
say:14:1210708011:0.source_cn: 枷锁号是水鬼帮的大船，而且是可以和死潮舰队的不死号媲美...
say:14:1210708011:0.male: The Chainkeeper is the Wights' flagship, rivaling even the beautiful Immortal that the Dead Tide Fleet owns! I heard that's where the Wights' boss stays.
say:14:1210708011:0.female: The Chainkeeper is the Wights' flagship, rivaling even the beautiful Immortal that the Dead Tide Fleet owns! I heard that's where the Wights' boss stays.

say:15:1210708012:0.text: On top of that... We might even find Nara on that ship.
say:15:1210708012:0.source_cn: 说不定除了泰西欧，我们还能见到奈拉。
say:15:1210708012:0.male: On top of that... We might even find Nara on that ship.
say:15:1210708012:0.female: On top of that... We might even find Nara on that ship.

say:16:1210708013:0.text: Excellent. Things are going quite smoothly with you here, Sinbad.
say:16:1210708013:0.source_cn: 很好，这趟突袭，有你在，事半功倍。

say:0:1210709001:0.text: This is their camp gate, we can't pass through.
say:0:1210709001:0.source_cn: 这是他们营地的大门，我们过不去。

say:1:1210709002:0.text: Follow me, I know a shortcut.
say:1:1210709002:0.source_cn: 跟我来，我知道一条绕进去的捷径。

say:2:1210710003:0.text: It's the sound of iron chains rattling in the wind. These Wights are scary...
say:2:1210710003:0.source_cn: 是铁链被风吹的声音。这帮水鬼真野蛮……

say:0:1210711001:0.text: We're here. Climb up from here and we'll be in their camp.
say:0:1210711001:0.source_cn: 到了，从这里爬上去，就是水鬼营地内部了。

say:1:1210712002:0.text: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, we need to go help them!
say:1:1210712002:0.male: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, we need to go help them!
say:1:1210712002:0.female: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, we need to go help them!

say:0:1210717001:0.text: They mentioned that the captain invested some kind of power in Nara. What does that mean?
say:0:1210717001:0.source_cn: 她们刚才说船长把那种力量用在了奈拉身上，是什么意思？

say:1:1210717002:0.text: From what I've heard, it seems to be related to how the Dead Tide Fleet recruits members, but I couldn't find out any details.
say:1:1210717002:0.source_cn: 好像是和死潮舰队怎么新增船员有关，别的我也没查到。

say:2:1210717003:0.text: Let's go check on that couple first.

say:3:1210719001:0.text: Ma'am, we're here to rescue you. Please don't be scared.
say:3:1210719001:0.source_cn: 女士，我们是来救你们的，别害怕。

say:4:1210719002:0.text: You're safe now. No one will harm you again.
say:4:1210719002:0.source_cn: 你们安全了，不会再有人伤害你们了。

say:9:1210719004:0.text: Let's lower your husband down first—
say:9:1210719004:0.source_cn: 那我们先把你丈夫放下来——

say:10:1210719005:0.text: No! This starfish-eating dung deserves what's coming to him!
say:10:1210719005:0.source_cn: 但我不想救他！你们也不要插手！这是他应得的。

say:13:1210719006:0.text: You guys must have a bigger goal here, right? Why don't you check for any other hostages, and I can just... stay here and watch over him.
say:13:1210719006:0.source_cn: 我会在这里看着他的……你们应该……还有别的事要忙吧？

choice_prompt:14:1210719006.text: You guys must have a bigger goal here, right? Why don't you check for any other hostages, and I can just... stay here and watch over him.
choice_prompt:14:1210719006.source_cn: 我会在这里看着他的……你们应该……还有别的事要忙吧？

say:15:1210719007:0.text: Do you know where Nara went?
say:15:1210719007:0.source_cn: 你知道奈拉会去哪里吗？

say:16:1210719008:0.text: Are you planning to confront her? She probably returned to the ship...
say:16:1210719008:0.source_cn: 你们要去找她算账？她……她应该回船了……

say:17:1210719009:0.text: I've left a mark for my subordinates. They'll arrive soon, don't worry.
say:17:1210719009:0.source_cn: 我给血薇帮的弟兄留了记号，他们随后就会来。放心，他们会...

say:21:1210719011:0.text: I'm not sure, but she seemed important. The other Water Wights salute her whenever she passes.
say:21:1210719011:0.source_cn: 我也不知道，但她好像地位不低，别的水鬼见了她都要行礼。
say:21:1210719011:0.male: I'm not sure, but she seemed important. The other Water Wights salute her whenever she passes.
say:21:1210719011:0.female: I'm not sure, but she seemed important. The other Water Wights salute her whenever she passes.

say:22:1210719012:0.text: I didn't recognize her voice earlier, but I know of her—<style="highlight">Bonnie, the first mate of the Dead Tide Fleet</style>.
say:22:1210719012:0.male: I didn't recognize her voice earlier, but I know of her—<style="highlight">Bonnie, the first mate of the Dead Tide Fleet</style>.
say:22:1210719012:0.female: I didn't recognize her voice earlier, but I know of her—<style="highlight">Bonnie, the first mate of the Dead Tide Fleet</style>.

say:23:1210719013:0.text: Are you... here to get rid of the monsters?
say:23:1210719013:0.source_cn: 你们……是来铲除这帮恶鬼的吗？

say:27:1210719014:0.text: Yes! Sir Chippy will chase all the bad guys away for you, m'lady!
say:27:1210719014:0.source_cn: 没错，骑士满满会把坏人都打跑的！

say:28:1210719015:0.source_cn: 那就谢谢你们了，太好了……！

choice_prompt:29:1210719015.source_cn: 那就谢谢你们了，太好了……！

say:30:1210719016:0.text: Tesio...? Oh! You're here to rescue a companion, right? I don't know anyone called Tesio, but I do remember an old man with the same rose mark on his chest like the one you have. They took him onto the ship.
say:30:1210719016:0.source_cn: 泰西欧……？噢！我知道了，你们是来救同伴的，有个老头，...
say:30:1210719016:0.male: Tesio...? Oh! You're here to rescue a companion, right? I don't know anyone called Tesio, but I do remember an old man with the same rose mark on his chest like the one you have. They took him onto the ship.
say:30:1210719016:0.female: Tesio...? Oh! You're here to rescue a companion, right? I don't know anyone called Tesio, but I do remember an old man with the same rose mark on his chest like the one you have. They took him onto the ship.

say:33:1210719019:0.text: I was right, Tesio's on the Chainkeeper!
say:33:1210719019:0.source_cn: 我猜得没错，泰西欧果然在枷锁号上！

say:36:1210719020:0.text: Should we go after Nara first or search for Tesio?
say:36:1210719020:0.source_cn: 那我们是先追奈拉还是去找泰西欧呀？

say:37:1210719021:0.text: Nara was also heading towards the Chainkeeper. I believe we'll be able to find both of them there.
say:37:1210719021:0.source_cn: 奈拉往枷锁号的方向走了，我们跟上，也许都能碰到。

say:41:1210719022:0.text: Ma'am, thank you for the information. You're now under the Carmine Whispers' protection, but before we go, I have something to say.
say:41:1210719022:0.source_cn: 女士，感谢你提供的情报，血薇会庇佑你的。在走之前，我有...

say:46:1210719017:0.text: Yes, an old man with that mark on his chest was taken aboard by the Wights.
say:46:1210719017:0.source_cn: 见过，他被水鬼带进船了。
say:46:1210719017:0.male: Yes, an old man with that mark on his chest was taken aboard by the Wights.
say:46:1210719017:0.female: Yes, an old man with that mark on his chest was taken aboard by the Wights.

choice:29:1:2.text: Does this rose mark look familiar?
choice:29:1:2.source_cn: 你见过一个胸前别花的老头吗
choice:29:1:2.male: Does this rose mark look familiar?
choice:29:1:2.female: Does this rose mark look familiar?

say:47:1210719018:0.text: Come to think of it, I did see an old man in a red coat. They took him onto the boat.
say:47:1210719018:0.source_cn: 还有个穿红色大衣的老头，水鬼帮把他带进船上了。
say:47:1210719018:0.male: Come to think of it, I did see an old man in a red coat. They took him onto the boat.
say:47:1210719018:0.female: Come to think of it, I did see an old man in a red coat. They took him onto the boat.

choice:29:2:3.source_cn: 这里除了亡灵还有没有别的人

choice:20:0:1.text: Who was the other person just now?
choice:20:0:1.male: Who was the other person just now?
choice:20:0:1.female: Who was the other person just now?

choice:20:1:2.text: Was that other lady a Graveborn?
choice:20:1:2.male: Was that other lady a Graveborn?
choice:20:1:2.female: Was that other lady a Graveborn?

choice:14:0:1.text: I'm not sure this is a good idea.
choice:14:0:1.male: I'm not sure this is a good idea.
choice:14:0:1.female: I'm not sure this is a good idea.

choice:14:1:2.text: I'd rather not leave you alone.
choice:14:1:2.source_cn: 有，但不会对你们见死不救
choice:14:1:2.male: I'd rather not leave you alone.
choice:14:1:2.female: I'd rather not leave you alone.

say:0:1210721001:0.text: Magister, Chippy sees Nara boarding the ship!
say:0:1210721001:0.male: Magister, Chippy sees Nara boarding the ship!
say:0:1210721001:0.female: Magister, Chippy sees Nara boarding the ship!

say:1:1210721002:0.text: So this is the Water Wights' <style="highlight">Chainkeeper</style>. *Whistles* She's a beauty! Let's get moving, Nara and Tesio should both be on board.
say:1:1210721002:0.source_cn: 这就是水鬼帮的<style=highlight>枷锁号...

say:3:1210723001:0.text: Why does Sonja look so hesitant?
say:3:1210723001:0.source_cn: 索尼娅为什么停下了脚步？

say:4:1210723002:0.text: She's torn because, after all, her sister is the enemy. Does she really want to be the one to bring her down?
say:4:1210723002:0.source_cn: 因为在犹豫吧，毕竟敌人是妹妹，难道要亲手杀死亲妹妹？

say:5:1210723003:1.text: Actually... I've already led her to her death once...
say:5:1210723003:1.source_cn: 其实……我已经“杀死”过她一次。

say:7:1210723005:1.text: Nara and I grew up in Rustport. We were orphans and barely scraping by, so we turned to theft for survival. Nara hated it. She dreamed of leaving, so we saved up and bought two tickets out.
say:7:1210723005:1.source_cn: 我和奈拉从小在锈锚港长大，我们没有父母，找不到工作，只...

say:8:1210723006:0.text: But during our voyage, disaster struck—a tsunami capsized our ship. I was holding onto her hand, but a monstrous wave swept her away...
say:8:1210723006:0.source_cn: 但航行途中，我们遇到了海啸，船翻了。我本来抓住了奈拉的...

choice_prompt:9:1210723006.text: But during our voyage, disaster struck—a tsunami capsized our ship. I was holding onto her hand, but a monstrous wave swept her away...
choice_prompt:9:1210723006.source_cn: 但航行途中，我们遇到了海啸，船翻了。我本来抓住了奈拉的手，但一个大浪过来，她不见了……

say:10:1210723007:1.text: I know, but... if I had just held on tighter, or never brought her aboard that ship, or searched more diligently for her, then maybe...
say:10:1210723007:1.source_cn: 我知道，但……如果我当时再抓紧一点，如果我没有带她上那...

say:11:1210723008:0.text: You can't go down that path. What's done is done. You've got to learn how to move on. At the very least, find a way to talk it out with Nara, and don't let her blame the wrong person.
say:11:1210723008:0.source_cn: 没有也许，也没有如果，事情已经发生，你得学会让它翻篇。...

say:12:1210723009:0.text: I don't even know how to explain it to her... She thinks I abandoned her and betrayed her.
say:12:1210723009:0.source_cn: ……我不知道怎么和她解释，她以为我抛下了她，背叛了她。

say:13:1210723010:0.text: Didn't you see what she did with that couple? She put them through hell just to test whether they would betray each other.
say:13:1210723010:0.source_cn: 看得出来，她折磨那对夫妻，也是因为想求证他们会不会背叛彼此。

say:14:1210723011:1.text: Perhaps that's her way of expressing her subconscious trauma...
say:14:1210723011:1.source_cn: 但她自己好像没有意识到呢……

say:17:1210723012:1.text: It's not your fault. You were just a kid back then, right?
say:17:1210723012:1.source_cn: 索尼娅不要自责啦，这也不能算索尼娅的错，当年的索尼娅也...

say:18:1210723013:1.text: Let's find Nara and clear the air!
say:18:1210723013:1.source_cn: 我们待会找到奈拉，和她说清楚吧！

choice_prompt:19:1210723013.text: Let's find Nara and clear the air!
choice_prompt:19:1210723013.source_cn: 我们待会找到奈拉，和她说清楚吧！

say:20:1210723014:1.text: Do you really think so? With all that deep-seated resentment and her unpredictable nature, will she even listen?
say:20:1210723014:1.source_cn: 认真的吗？那么深厚的仇恨，以她现在反复无常的个性，她能...
say:20:1210723014:1.male: Do you really think so? With all that deep-seated resentment and her unpredictable nature, will she even listen?
say:20:1210723014:1.female: Do you really think so? With all that deep-seated resentment and her unpredictable nature, will she even listen?

say:21:1210723018:1.text: Enough chatter. We're in the Wights' camp, we shouldn't linger in one place for too long.
say:21:1210723018:1.source_cn: 这里是水鬼的营地，不能再聊下去了。

say:22:1210723019:1.text: But trust me. No matter what happens, I'll make sure Nara won't harm you.
say:22:1210723019:1.source_cn: 但是我的伙伴们，请放心，待会无论发生什么，我可以保证，...

say:23:1210723020:1.text: With Sonja here, Chippy feels safe as houses!
say:23:1210723020:1.source_cn: 有索尼娅在，就会安全感满满！

say:26:1210723021:1.source_cn: 那还等什么？梅林，我们去找奈拉吧！

say:28:1210723015:1.text: I agree. Didn't you see her just now? She strikes me as someone who acts first and talks later.
say:28:1210723015:1.source_cn: 我敢打赌，她绝不会乖乖接受道歉。
say:28:1210723015:1.male: I agree. Didn't you see her just now? She strikes me as someone who acts first and talks later.
say:28:1210723015:1.female: I agree. Didn't you see her just now? She strikes me as someone who acts first and talks later.

say:29:1210723016:1.text: I bet we'll get a knife pulled on us before we even get a word out!
say:29:1210723016:1.source_cn: 要我看，她只会说——“你们，去死吧！”
say:29:1210723016:1.male: I bet we'll get a knife pulled on us before we even get a word out!
say:29:1210723016:1.female: I bet we'll get a knife pulled on us before we even get a word out!

say:30:1210723017:1.text: I agree. This reminds me of a song I heard from a minstrel in Rustport: "She's a ghost from the past, out to collect pain at last. She's a specter from days gone by, here to make me cry."
say:30:1210723017:1.source_cn: 我也觉得。就像吟游诗人唱的那样：“她是来自过去的幽灵，...
say:30:1210723017:1.male: I agree. This reminds me of a song I heard from a minstrel in Rustport: "She's a ghost from the past, out to collect pain at last. She's a specter from days gone by, here to make me cry."
say:30:1210723017:1.female: I agree. This reminds me of a song I heard from a minstrel in Rustport: "She's a ghost from the past, out to collect pain at last. She's a specter from days gone by, here to make me cry."

choice:19:2:3.text: I don't think it'll be that easy.
choice:19:2:3.source_cn: 仇恨不会这么轻易消弭
choice:19:2:3.male: I don't think it'll be that easy.
choice:19:2:3.female: I don't think it'll be that easy.

say:1:1210725002:0.text: *Coughing* There are so many cobwebs! Do they ever clean around here?
say:1:1210725002:0.source_cn: 咳咳咳，好多蜘蛛网，他们都不打扫吗？

say:0:1210726101:0.text: This place is kind of creepy... Is this where the Graveborns live?
say:0:1210726101:0.source_cn: 好阴森……这就是亡灵生活的地方吗？

say:1:1210726102:0.text: It feels colder than the outside.
say:1:1210726102:0.source_cn: 满满感觉空气都比外面冷了。

say:2:1210726103:0.text: Nara doesn't seem to be here.

say:4:1210726105:0.text: Look, there's another room over there!

say:0:1210727001:0.text: A room full of cannons? There's so many of them!

say:2:1210727003:0.text: They churned these out so fast. Don't they ever sleep?
say:2:1210727003:0.source_cn: 短时间造了这么多，他们不睡觉的吗？

say:0:1210728001:0.source_cn: 这里是他们吃饭的地方吗？

say:1:1210728002:0.text: Ugh, the dishes are still dirty. What a mess.

say:2:1210728003:0.text: There's still no sign of Nara.

say:2:1210729001:0.text: We're wasting time here. Sonja, based on what you know of Nara, where would she go?
say:2:1210729001:0.source_cn: 这样找下去太浪费时间了。索尼娅，以你对奈拉的了解，她会在哪？

say:3:1210729002:0.text: I'm not sure... My memories of Nara are mostly from our childhood.
say:3:1210729002:0.source_cn: ……不知道，我只了解小时候的奈拉。

say:8:1210729004:0.text: Yeah, there might be clues there!
say:8:1210729004:0.source_cn: 对，船长室说不定有收获！
say:8:1210729004:0.male: Yeah, there might be clues there!
say:8:1210729004:0.female: Yeah, there might be clues there!

say:9:1210729011:0.text: Sir Chippy will bravely lead you all! Let's go!
say:9:1210729011:0.source_cn: 满满骑士得令，即刻出发——目标是船长室！

say:11:1210729005:0.text: Perhaps we should check the captain's quarters. Even if we don't find Nara, maybe we'll find Tesio.
say:11:1210729005:0.source_cn: 那我提议去船长室找找，就算碰不到奈拉，说不定能找到泰西欧。
say:11:1210729005:0.male: Perhaps we should check the captain's quarters. Even if we don't find Nara, maybe we'll find Tesio.
say:11:1210729005:0.female: Perhaps we should check the captain's quarters. Even if we don't find Nara, maybe we'll find Tesio.

say:16:1210729006:0.text: Oh no! Do you think this might be a trap? Should we get off this ship right away?!
say:16:1210729006:0.source_cn: 主人是说可能有诈？那我们是不是应该马上离开这里？！
say:16:1210729006:0.male: Oh no! Do you think this might be a trap? Should we get off this ship right away?!
say:16:1210729006:0.female: Oh no! Do you think this might be a trap? Should we get off this ship right away?!

say:17:1210729007:0.text: No! Look, we've worked too hard to sneak in here. This is our golden chance to dismantle the Wights' hideout.
say:17:1210729007:0.source_cn: 别啊，好不容易混进来了，这可是一把端掉水鬼窝最好的机会。

say:18:1210729008:0.text: Let's check out the captain's quarters. They should have schematics of the entire ship so that if there's any trouble, we'll be ready.
say:18:1210729008:0.source_cn: 这样吧，我们去船长室看看，那里应该有整个船舱的构造图，...

say:20:1210729010:0.text: Like embarking on a legendary quest to take over the Chainkeeper! Chippy, why don't you lead the way?
say:20:1210729010:0.source_cn: 比如说，开展一段夺取枷锁号的传奇故事。满满骑士，你要开路吗？

say:0:1210730001:0.text: Hah. We didn't find Nara, but we did stumble across something much more interesting. Well, well, old friend, fancy meeting you here!
say:0:1210730001:0.source_cn: 呵，奈拉没找到，先碰到老熟人了，又见面了，泰西欧先生！

say:1:1210730002:0.text: Y-you... How did you get in here?!
say:1:1210730002:0.source_cn: 你们，你们竟然潜入了这里？！

say:2:1210731001:1.text: What a pity that the Wights left you with no protection.
say:2:1210731001:1.source_cn: 真遗憾，水鬼并不打算保护你。

say:3:1210731002:1.text: Sonja, you've got what you wanted, but do you really have to go this far?
say:3:1210731002:1.source_cn: 索尼娅，你已经得到了你要的，难道非要赶尽杀绝吗？

say:4:1210731003:1.text: After all, I am your father! Your father!!
say:4:1210731003:1.source_cn: 我毕竟是你的父亲！父亲！！！

say:5:1210731004:1.text: How much of our brethren's blood has stained your hands while you colluded with the Water Wights?
say:5:1210731004:1.source_cn: 你和水鬼勾结，手上沾了多少血薇弟兄的血？

say:6:1210731005:1.text: I am their boss. Dying for me is what they should do!
say:6:1210731005:1.source_cn: 我是帮主，他们为我而死，天经地义！

say:8:1210731007:1.text: If I'm going down, then I'll take you down with me!

say:3:1210733002:1.text: I'm getting old after all. Not as sharp as before...
say:3:1210733002:1.source_cn: 到底还是老了，不如以前了……

say:4:1210733003:1.text: If I were younger, stronger, more agile... you wouldn't stand a chance.
say:4:1210733003:1.source_cn: 如果我还年轻，体魄强健，手指灵活……你们不是我的对手。

say:5:1210733004:1.source_cn: 属于你的时代已经过去了。

say:7:1210733006:1.text: You could have lived out your days in peace.
say:7:1210733006:1.source_cn: 你本来可以安度晚年的。

say:8:1210733007:1.text: *Deep chuckles* Retirement? Sitting on my thumbs, soaking up the sun? I'd rather die!
say:8:1210733007:1.source_cn: 呵呵……安度晚年？无所事事地吹海风、晒太阳？那种生活…...

say:9:1210733008:1.text: Sonja, from the day I took you in, I knew you'd rise to the top. You'd be my right hand.
say:9:1210733008:1.source_cn: 索尼娅，收养你的时候，我就知道你会有出息。你会成为我的...

say:10:1210733009:1.text: But now... You can't do this to me! I built the Whispers up through my blood, sweat, and tears. This gang would be nothing without me!
say:10:1210733009:1.source_cn: 但是，你不能夺走我的生命。对于一个掌控帮派的老人，失去...

say:11:1210733010:1.text: If only you were truly my child... then I'm sure you would be much more loyal.
say:11:1210733010:1.source_cn: 多希望你真的是我孩子……那样你就会永远在身边辅佐我。

say:12:1210733011:1.text: You already control way too many people. I'm glad I'm not one of them.
say:12:1210733011:1.source_cn: 你手下的亡魂太多。我很庆幸我不是。

say:13:1210733012:1.text: Do not forget that I am the one who made you what you are! Deny it all you want, but you will never escape me... Hahahaha!!!
say:13:1210733012:1.source_cn: 我亲手塑造了你，即便你不承认，你也永远没法摆脱我……哈...

say:19:1210733014:1.text: Shut your mouth. Don't think you'll get a quick, easy death by taunting us.
say:19:1210733014:1.source_cn: 放轻松，只是卸了你的下巴。

say:20:1210733015:1.text: Our score isn't settled yet. I'll gladly wait until the day you're judged in court and you can finally face your sins.
say:20:1210733015:1.source_cn: 想自尽？别啊，我们俩的恩怨还没算，你怎么可以去死呢？

choice_prompt:21:1210733015.text: Our score isn't settled yet. I'll gladly wait until the day you're judged in court and you can finally face your sins.
choice_prompt:21:1210733015.source_cn: 想自尽？别啊，我们俩的恩怨还没算，你怎么可以去死呢？

say:22:1210733016:1.text: You guys go on ahead. I'll join you after I tie him up nice and properly so that he can't escape before he goes to trial.
say:22:1210733016:1.source_cn: 放心，你们继续找，我留在这里把他绑起来，免得他缺席血薇...
say:22:1210733016:1.male: You guys go on ahead. I'll join you after I tie him up nice and properly so that he can't escape before he goes to trial.
say:22:1210733016:1.female: You guys go on ahead. I'll join you after I tie him up nice and properly so that he can't escape before he goes to trial.

say:24:1210733018:1.text: Don't worry, I'll catch up to you guys soon!
say:24:1210733018:1.source_cn: 放心，我稍后就赶上你们。

choice:21:0:1.text: We still need to find Nara.
choice:21:0:1.male: We still need to find Nara.
choice:21:0:1.female: We still need to find Nara.

say:0:1210734001:0.text: Is Sinbad taking his revenge on Tesio...?
say:0:1210734001:0.source_cn: 辛巴达不会趁机报复泰西欧吧……？

say:1:1210734002:0.text: Don't worry, he'll make sure Tesio can make it to the trial. He won't hurt him too bad.
say:1:1210734002:0.source_cn: 泰西欧还要接受审判，辛巴达不会弄死他的。

say:0:1210735001:0.text: Ah... whew... we finally made it to the deck!

say:1:1210735002:0.text: There aren't many guards here... this is quite suspicious.
say:1:1210735002:0.source_cn: 很奇怪，守卫不多，像是故意的……

say:2:1210736001:1.text: Sonja, you finally made it! I've been waiting, waiting, waiting!
say:2:1210736001:1.source_cn: 姐姐，你终于来了？我等你好久了！

say:3:1210736002:0.text: ... You knew about us all along?

say:4:1210736003:0.text: Did you think I only had eyes for that dumb Bonnie? Oh, you sweet, naive thing! Hahaha!
say:4:1210736003:0.source_cn: 不然呢，你以为我只发现了波妮那个蠢货吗？！天真哈哈哈哈！

choice_prompt:5:1210736003.text: Did you think I only had eyes for that dumb Bonnie? Oh, you sweet, naive thing! Hahaha!
choice_prompt:5:1210736003.source_cn: 不然呢，你以为我只发现了波妮那个蠢货吗？！天真哈哈哈哈！

say:6:1210736004:0.text: Zip it! When my sister and I are talking, you keep your trap shut!
say:6:1210736004:0.source_cn: 喂，你是什么东西？我和姐姐在聊天的时候，给我闭上嘴！
say:6:1210736004:0.male: Zip it! When my sister and I are talking, you keep your trap shut!
say:6:1210736004:0.female: Zip it! When my sister and I are talking, you keep your trap shut!

say:7:1210736005:0.text: Weren't you looking for Tesio, Sonja? I brought him right to you. How was it? Did ya have fun?
say:7:1210736005:0.source_cn: 姐姐，你不是想要泰西欧吗？我送给你啦，怎么样，玩得开心吗？

say:8:1210736006:0.text: Judging by your face, you're not having as much fun as I am. What's the matter? I... couldn't be happier!
say:8:1210736006:0.source_cn: 瞧你的表情，好像不是很开心呢……怎么办？我可……开心地...

say:10:1210736008:0.text: Enough with that pitying look. Don't treat me like I'm dead! My body may be wrecked, but my ears are sharp.
say:10:1210736008:0.source_cn: 收起你可笑的怜悯，别把我当个死人！！虽然我的身体的确破...

say:11:1210736009:0.text: Right now, I hear your heart pounding like crazy and the blood rushing through your veins.
say:11:1210736009:0.source_cn: 比如现在，我就听到了你胸膛……用力收缩的……心脏，还有...

say:12:1210736010:0.text: Oh, sister dear, don't tell me you're nervous, or maybe even a little... scared?
say:12:1210736010:0.source_cn: 噢，不是吧？亲爱的姐姐，你的心跳告诉我，你很紧张？还有...

say:13:1210736011:0.text: What's got you trembling? Me? My hook? Or are you scared you'll end up like me?
say:13:1210736011:0.source_cn: 你在怕什么？怕我？怕我的钩锁，还是……怕我把你也变成我这样？

say:15:1210736013:0.text: Hahahaha! I see now. You're afraid... of my hatred?
say:15:1210736013:0.source_cn: 哈哈哈哈哈哈！我知道了，你怕……我的恨？

say:17:1210736015:0.text: Ha! It's just too funny! *Manic laughter*
say:17:1210736015:0.source_cn: 哈哈哈……哈哈哈哈哈……哈哈！太好笑了哈哈哈哈……

say:18:1210736016:0.text: Can you do anything but laugh now?

say:19:1210736017:0.text: Since you're not in the mood to chat, then say hello to my hook. It's been dying to meet you...
say:19:1210736017:0.source_cn: ……既然你不想和我叙旧，那就来和我的钩锁打招呼吧，它可...

say:20:1210736018:0.text: Your head, your heart, your limbs... It wants them all!
say:20:1210736018:0.source_cn: ——你的头，你的心脏，四肢，它全都想割下来呢！！！

say:0:1210742001:0.text: My head's spinning... Are we... stranded again?
say:0:1210742001:0.source_cn: 唔，头好晕，我们这是……又搁浅了吗？

say:2:1210742003:0.text: I'm unharmed. What's the status of the Chainkeeper?
say:2:1210742003:0.source_cn: 没受伤。枷锁号怎么样了？
say:2:1210742003:0.male: I'm unharmed. What's the status of the Chainkeeper?
say:2:1210742003:0.female: I'm unharmed. What's the status of the Chainkeeper?

say:5:1210701001:0.text: Yay, we've finally reached Lookout Point! And we didn't run into any creepy sea monsters on the way!
say:5:1210701001:0.source_cn: 太好了！终于平安到瞭望角了！一路上也没遇到海怪！

say:6:1210701002:1.text: Yeah, but there are so many guards here... How do we get in?
say:6:1210701002:1.source_cn: 但这里的守卫很多……我们要怎么进去？

say:9:1210701003:1.text: They're just lackeys. They're no match for us.
say:9:1210701003:1.source_cn: 只是喽啰，不是我们的对手。

say:12:1210701004:0.text: Come on, we don't always have to use brute force.

say:13:1210701005:1.text: We could knock a few of them out, steal their clothes, and just sneak in! Easy-peasy, right?
say:13:1210701005:1.source_cn: 随手打晕几个水鬼，换上他们的衣服，不就能光明正大地进去了？

say:14:1210701006:1.text: I suppose you're right. We should conserve our energy.

say:15:1210701007:1.text: Let's go for those guards at the entrance. It's their lucky day!
say:15:1210701007:1.source_cn: 那就选守在入口的那几个幸运儿吧。

narration:18:12010711:0.text: You finally arrive at the Lookout Point, but it is hard to sneak into the camp with Water Wights everywhere.
narration:18:12010711:0.source_cn: 你们终于抵达了瞭望角，但这里四处都是水鬼帮，难以闯入。

say:5:1210713002:0.text: *Evil cackling* More! Scream louder, let me hear your desperation!
say:5:1210713002:0.source_cn: 哈哈哈哈，不够！再叫得更惨一点，更绝望一点！

say:7:1210713004:0.text: Ugh. What a waste. These two cowards can't even scream properly.
say:7:1210713004:0.source_cn: 两个废物，惨叫都叫不出声。

say:8:1210713005:0.text: Alright then. Do you want to live?

say:9:1210713006:0.text: Here, take this vial of potion. One of you drinks, and the other goes free.
say:9:1210713006:0.source_cn: 这里有一瓶药水，你们选个人喝下去，我就把另一个放了。

say:10:1210713007:0.text: What will happen if we drink it?

say:15:1210713010:0.text: How is this better than being dead?!
say:15:1210713010:0.source_cn: ……变成这样，和死了有什么区别？

say:18:1210713011:0.text: It's your choice. Pick who dies, or you both perish together.
say:18:1210713011:0.source_cn: 就看你们是选死一个，还是一起死咯？

say:20:1210713013:0.text: *Manic laughter* Wouldn't you do anything for your wife?
say:20:1210713013:0.source_cn: 哈哈哈！你不是说可以为她去死吗？

say:21:1210713014:0.text: I'm giving you that precious chance. Why not thank me? Thank me! Hahaha!
say:21:1210713014:0.source_cn: 我给你实现愿望的机会，为什么不感谢我？感谢我呀！哈哈哈哈！

say:23:1210713016:0.text: But if you can't choose, well, I guess I should pick for you! Eenie meenie...
say:23:1210713016:0.source_cn: 不选的话，我就让它帮你们选了？

say:32:1210713018:0.text: Raya, I... I'm willing to die for you. Let me drink it!
say:32:1210713018:0.source_cn: 拉亚，我……我愿意为了你去死，让我喝吧！

say:33:1210713019:0.text: Tyrus, if only one of us can survive, it should be you! I'll drink it!
say:33:1210713019:0.source_cn: 提尔，如果只能活一个，我宁愿是你！让我喝！

say:34:1210713020:0.text: If you die, there would be nothing worth living for!
say:34:1210713020:0.source_cn: 你要是死了，我活着还有什么意思？

say:35:1210713021:0.text: Then let's drink it together! Give us the potion!
say:35:1210713021:0.source_cn: 那就一起喝吧！把药给我们！

say:38:1210713023:0.text: My love, not even death can separate us...
say:38:1210713023:0.source_cn: 提尔，这下连死亡都没法分开我们了……

say:40:1210713025:0.text: You—you didn't drink it just now? You lied to me?!
say:40:1210713025:0.source_cn: 你——你刚才没有把药水咽下去？你在骗我？！！

say:41:1210713026:0.text: I'm sorry, but... I wanna live.
say:41:1210713026:0.source_cn: 对不起，但是……我想活下去。

say:42:1210713027:0.text: You said you'd die for me. You dirty liar! Go drown yourself!
say:42:1210713027:0.source_cn: 你还说愿意为我死？！！你骗我！！！

say:46:1210713028:0.text: Ahahaha...! This kind of drama, no matter how many times I see it, never gets old.
say:46:1210713028:0.source_cn: 啊哈哈哈……！这样的戏码，无论看多少次，都不会厌烦。

say:47:1210713029:0.text: Is seawater really that delicious? Salty enough to keep tears from falling?
say:47:1210713029:0.source_cn: 海水好喝吗？有没有苦到连眼泪都流不出来？

say:50:1210713032:0.text: Hahaha! How could you be so naive to believe those sweet lies about dying for each other?
say:50:1210713032:0.source_cn: 哈哈哈哈哈哈！谁让你们天真，居然相信什么愿意为你去死的谎话！

say:59:1210715001:0.text: Oh, it's just you. Do you enjoy slinking around in the shadows all the time? Ugh, you're so dark and gloomy! It ruins my mood.
say:59:1210715001:0.source_cn: 啊，是你。你很喜欢偷听吗？

say:60:1210715002:0.text: Nara, are you wasting these two specimens?
say:60:1210715002:0.source_cn: 奈拉，你浪费了两个材料。

say:61:1210715003:0.text: Hey! I caught these two with my own hands. I have the right to deal with them. The captain gave me that authority!
say:61:1210715003:0.source_cn: 那两个家伙是我抓的，任我处置，船长说我有这个权利！

say:62:1210715004:0.text: The day of reckoning is coming soon. The captain invested such precious power in you. I hope you do not disappoint him.
say:62:1210715004:0.source_cn: ……决战日快到了，船长把那么珍贵的力量用在了你身上，别...

say:63:1210715005:0.text: Go back to the shadows and loom over someone else. I'm tired of your yapping.
say:63:1210715005:0.source_cn: 真吵啊，这些话早都听腻了。

say:64:1210715006:0.text: Hmm. I bet you're really scared of letting him down, aren't you?
say:64:1210715006:0.source_cn: 我看是你……很害怕让他失望吧？

say:66:1210715008:0.text: If it weren't for the captain's orders, I'd have taken your head off ten times over. Imagine it, dangling from a hook—such a delightful decoration!
say:66:1210715008:0.source_cn: 要不是船长拦着，你的头早被我割下来十次了。串在钩索上会...

say:67:1210715009:0.text: I've made my stance clear. Proceed as you wish.
say:67:1210715009:0.source_cn: 够了。该提醒的我都提醒了，你好自为之。

say:70:1210715011:0.text: Now that's ruined my mood, I should go back to doing something fun! Back to my two little playthings... Let me think...
say:70:1210715011:0.source_cn: 来人，把这两个人……我想想……

say:71:1210715012:0.text: Oh, I know! Guard! Come put a noose around the man, and give the rope to the woman!
say:71:1210715012:0.source_cn: 男的吊起来，绳子给女的。

say:72:1210715013:0.text: *Evil giggle* Seeing as you, good sir, just lied to this pretty lady, she's probably dying to kill you. I'll give her the rope that decides your fate. Let's see if she saves you. It'll be sooo interesting!
say:72:1210715013:0.source_cn: 嘿！你刚骗了她，她恨不能杀了你。我把掌握你命运的绳子给...

say:74:1210715014:0.text: N-no! Wait! I'll die for sure, please!
say:74:1210715014:0.source_cn: 不！别！我会死的——不要，不要！

say:75:1210715015:0.text: Hahaha! Hearing you beg is so exhilarating. But why are you begging me? Shouldn't you be begging that little lady for your life?
say:75:1210715015:0.source_cn: 哈哈哈哈……！求我，不如求她！

say:76:1210715016:0.text: Anyways... These two are no fun anymore. Let's find some other entertainment.
say:76:1210715016:0.source_cn: 哈哈…这俩人没意思了，去找点别的乐子。

narration:82:12010734:0.text: Nara is sharp enough to catch someone eavesdropping. As you are gripped by anxiety, a female Graveborn walks up to Nara.
narration:82:12010734:0.source_cn: 奈拉敏锐地发现了有人在偷听。正当你们心惊之际，另一个女...

narration:83:12010734:0.text: Nara is sharp enough to catch someone eavesdropping. As you are gripped by anxiety, a female Graveborn walks up to Nara.
narration:83:12010734:0.source_cn: 奈拉敏锐地发现了有人在偷听。正当你们心惊之际，另一个女...

narration:2:1210724001:0.text: The team follows Nara onto the Chainkeeper...
narration:2:1210724001:0.source_cn: 我们跟随奈拉进入了枷锁号……

say:2:1210738001:1.text: Are you gonna do it? Are you gonna kill me, sister?
say:2:1210738001:1.source_cn: 哈哈哈哈……要杀了我吗？姐姐？

say:4:1210738003:1.text: Come on! Kill me, like you did eleven years ago! Do it again!
say:4:1210738003:1.source_cn: 来啊！杀了我吧，像十一年前那样！再一次杀了我吧！

say:8:1210738007:1.text: If you don't strike, I'll kill you instead sooner or later!
say:8:1210738007:1.source_cn: 你不动手，我迟早要杀了你！

say:9:1210738008:1.text: I'll keep your head right by my bed. Your eyes will watch me. Always watching! Watching as I tear bodies apart and snap their necks!
say:9:1210738008:1.source_cn: 我要把你的人头放在我的床边，我要你的眼睛看着我！一直看...

say:10:1210738009:1.text: See these scars, Sonja? They're just like sewing a rag doll together with fish bones and fishing lines!
say:10:1210738009:1.source_cn: 姐姐，看到了吗？这缝缝补补的伤口……就像做布娃娃一样，...

say:11:1210738010:1.text: I came back from the depths of the sea just to see you again!
say:11:1210738010:1.source_cn: 为了见你，我从海底回来了！

say:13:1210738012:1.text: Hahaha! That look in your eyes, yes! That's it! Keep looking at me just like that!
say:13:1210738012:1.source_cn: 呵哈哈哈……就是这样的眼神，你现在看着我的眼神！多棒啊……

say:14:1210738013:1.text: You were the one who taught me how to sew dolls. Did I learn well?
say:14:1210738013:1.source_cn: 你教我缝的布娃娃，我是不是学的很好？哈哈哈哈！！！

say:15:1210738014:0.text: What are you waiting for? Do it! Kill me... kill me!
say:15:1210738014:0.source_cn: 姐姐！还在犹豫什么呢？！动手啊！杀了我吧……杀了我吧！！！

say:16:1210738015:0.text: Even if you kill me, I'll find you again! Hahahaha!!
say:16:1210738015:0.source_cn: 就算你杀了我，我也会回来找你！啊哈哈哈哈哈！

narration:19:1210738017:0.text: Sonja, unable to harm Nara, reluctantly knocks her unconscious...
narration:19:1210738017:0.source_cn: 索尼娅终究不忍心伤害奈拉，无奈地把她打晕了……

say:21:1210738018:0.text: I'm sorry... I can't do it.

say:22:1210738019:0.text: I'll take her back and lock her up.
say:22:1210738019:0.source_cn: 我会把她带回去，关起来。

say:24:1210738020:1.text: We understand, Miss Sonja! This must have been a very difficult decision for you.
say:24:1210738020:1.source_cn: 我们明白的，这对你来说是个非常艰难的选择。

choice_prompt:25:1210738020.text: We understand, Miss Sonja! This must have been a very difficult decision for you.
choice_prompt:25:1210738020.source_cn: 我们明白的，这对你来说是个非常艰难的选择。

say:26:1210738021:0.text: But make sure to keep an eye on her! We can't afford to have her showing up in Rustport again. That would be hard to explain.
say:26:1210738021:0.source_cn: 至少别让她再在锈锚港民众面前出现，不然索尼娅你没法解释的。

say:28:1210738023:0.text: Let's deal with the other Wights. With Nara out of the picture, maybe they'll wise up and surrender.
say:28:1210738023:0.source_cn: 那么，去看看其他水鬼吧，老大都被我们收拾了，他们会不会...

cinematic_dialogue:32:1210739001:.text: They took out the boss lady!

narration:34:120107510:0.text: Seeing Nara defeated, the Water Wights on the Chainkeeper all surrender.
narration:34:120107510:0.source_cn: 看到奈拉被你们打败后，枷锁号上的水鬼全都主动投降了。

say:2:1210740001:0.text: These ruffians want to surrender! What should we do now?
say:2:1210740001:0.source_cn: 索尼娅，这帮水鬼要投降，我们接下来怎么办？

say:5:1210740003:0.text: Hey fellas! Did I hear you're seizing the ship? Guess I caught up at the right time!
say:5:1210740003:0.source_cn: ——嘿，我听到你们说要夺船？正好！看来我没错过什么。

say:6:1210740004:1.text: Sinbad, you're here. What about Tesio?
say:6:1210740004:1.source_cn: 辛巴达，你来了？泰西欧呢？

say:7:1210740005:0.text: I tied him up and dumped him in the hold, under the watchful eye of some other Whispers. Don't worry, we gave him some special treatment. He's not going anywhere.
say:7:1210740005:0.source_cn: 绑好了，丢在船舱里，血薇帮的弟兄们看着呢。别担心，给了...

say:10:1210740006:0.text: Boss, thanks to the marks you left us, we've taken full control of the Chainkeeper! We've gotten most of the ruffians settled. Anyone else who doesn't cooperate... can become fish food!
say:10:1210740006:0.source_cn: 大姐头，兄弟们跟着你留下的记号上船了。现在，枷锁号已经...

say:11:1210740007:0.text: Send a messenger back to Lucca to prepare a victory feast. The rest of you, tally up our spoils. If everything's in order, it's time to head back.
say:11:1210740007:0.source_cn: 派个人回去给卢卡送信，让他准备庆功宴。其余人清点一下战...

say:15:1210740009:1.text: Oh, need me at the helm? I know the way.
say:15:1210740009:1.source_cn: 要让我来掌舵吗？我知道怎么回去。

narration:22:120107511:0.text: A kraken attacks the Chainkeeper on your way back, causing it to run aground on an unfamiliar island.
narration:22:120107511:0.source_cn: 返程的路上，枷锁号被海怪袭击，被迫搁浅在一处陌生的海滩上。
